title: Comunicado 2025-01-28
summary: The BCCh Council unanimously held the policy rate at 5%, pausing the easing cycle. The message is cautious: although the macro scenario evolved broadly in line with the December IPoM and December CPI came in below forecast on food, the Council judges that risks to inflation have increased, which reinforces the need for caution, and gives no easing bias, only a data-dependent commitment to steer projected inflation to 3% within two years. The upside risks rest on a joint rise in cost factors (peso depreciation, higher labor costs, electricity tariffs), headline and core inflation rising to 4.5% and 4.3%, two-year expectations in the traders' survey drifting up to 3.5%, a stronger dollar and a slower Fed. This is the first BCCh document in the base, so there is no previous communique to compare against; on its own it reads as a hold with the risk balance tilted up and an inflation emphasis, without a cutting bias.

key_quotes.quote: La decisión fue adoptada por la unanimidad de sus miembros.
los riesgos para la inflación han aumentado, lo que refuerza la necesidad de cautela
key_quotes.context: Risk balance turned up; caution on further easing

key_quotes.quote: La dinámica inflacionaria reciente ha estado influida por el aumento conjunto de varios factores de costos, entre los que destacan la depreciación del peso, mayores costos laborales y el aumento de las tarifas eléctricas.
El Consejo evaluará los próximos movimientos de la TPM teniendo presente la evolución del escenario macroeconómico y sus implicancias para la convergencia inflacionaria.
key_quotes.context: Data-dependent guidance with no easing bias
